narr: The combination of abundant tropical moisture, moderate instability and a weak upper level disturbance produced thunderstorms with heavy rainfall across the Concho Valley and Heartland. A few of the thunderstorms produced flash flooding.
ev: An NWS Employee reported road impassable due to flood waters and the intersection of Westover Terrace and Forest Trail.
An NWS Employee reported water across the road at Sunset Drive next to the pond. The road is blocked off with barricades to stop motorists from crossing.
